To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DigiHelse intervention may be expected to improve the quality of home care services, and the potential socioeconomic value may be substantial.

the digital communication platform DigiHelse may be a cost-effective way of improving quality of home based care services in Norway, as the potential socioeconomic value was found to be 31.6 euro for each euro invested in the intervention over 10 years.

early health assessment may contribute to the development of digital health services by identifying quality outcomes, and that the use of a 10 year discounted cash flow analysis may provide a basis for assessing socioeconomic value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a digital communication platform for recipients of home care services to improve quality and value for the home care services and for the society.
the design and evaluation of a digital communication platform for home based health services in order to improve quality and value of care services.
the design of digital communication platforms to improve municipal care services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of the DigiHelse solution should be based on the results of this study.
this study shows the value of early stakeholder involvement and quantification of gains for improvement projects.
DigiHelse is a potentially valuable innovation that should be further developed and implemented in the Norwegian health care system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the design of a digital communication platform may have the potential to improve the quality of care services for the recipients of home care services and their dependants, while also reducing the burden of the health care system.
the digital communication platform DigiHelse has the potential to increase quality and value for the recipients, the home based health service and society.
the DigiHelse platform has the potential to increase the quality of care and the value for recipients of home based care services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the potential value of the DigiHelse intervention can be assessed and communicated to the decision makers in the public sector, to ensure the development and implementation of the intervention.
it is feasible to assess the potential socioeconomic value and risk of a health intervention at an early stage in the innovation process.
the use of a digital communication platform in the home care setting has the potential to improve the quality of care and reduce costs.
